scope: Controlled API/Run dispatcher comparison, not a production or 100-user load test

environment.deployment: single Python test process; no Kubernetes or service deployment

workload.arrival: all Runs accepted before dispatcher starts
workload.graph_stub: one async wait of 100 ms then success; no multi-stage agent flow
workload.timing_end: all Run coroutines returned and DB statuses are success

validation.warnings: Existing LangGraph durability-without-checkpointer warnings; no new warning type
validation.command: PYTHONPATH=src DTEST_IDENTITY_TEST_DATABASE_URL=<isolated-test-db> DTEST_CONCURRENCY_REPORT=<output.json> python -m pytest src/app/test src/agent_service/agents/analysis/tests -q

limits: No production concurrency recommendation follows from this microbenchmark.
Test DB uses NullPool; production pool saturation and aggregate replica connections were not measured.
Concurrent DB claims tested with independent sessions in one process, not separate Pods.
Executor completion projection uses controlled persisted graph snapshot, not an actual Redis/Executor end-to-end deployment.
No actual LLM, Executor, Kubernetes scaling, shared PV, or week-long wait was tested.
